tools.name: bodhi_deep_research-deep_research
tools.description:
Conduct deep research on a given topic and generate a comprehensive report.

This tool uses an AI-powered research workflow that:
1. Generates a research plan with multiple sections
2. Performs web searches to gather information
3. Writes detailed sections based on research findings
4. Compiles a final comprehensive report

The tool supports various configuration options for customization.

Args:
    topic: The research topic or question to investigate (required)
    instruction_img: Optional list of image file paths for vision-based instructions
    report_structure: Structure template for the report. Defaults to standard structure if not provided.
    json_report_format: Optional JSON string defining custom report structure. When provided, the report will be generated according to this structure and returned as JSON. If empty, uses default text format. See README for format specification.
    json_format_mode: Mode for JSON format validation. 'flexible' (default) allows custom JSON structures and normalizes partial/malformed input. 'strict' enforces the full JsonReportFormat schema. Only applies when json_report_format is provided.
    search_api: Search API to use: 'tavily', 'arxiv', 'reddit', 'rag', 'google'. For multiple APIs, use comma-separated values. Default: 'tavily'. Note: When using 'rag', it will ONLY search your local files in the ASK_BODHI vector database service using the provided Collection Name - no internet searches will be performed. RAG cannot be combined with other search APIs.
    search_api_config: Configuration dictionary for the search API (e.g., API keys, parameters). Pass as JSON string (e.g., '{"api_key": "value"}') or leave empty. For RAG mode, you can optionally provide additional search parameters here (e.g., '{"search_params": {"size": 10}}'). Note: collection_name should be provided as a top-level parameter when using RAG mode.
    collection_name: Collection name from ASK_BODHI when using RAG mode (search_api='rag'). Required when search_api='rag'. This is the name of the vector database collection containing your uploaded local files.
    number_of_queries: Number of search queries to generate per iteration. Default: 2
    max_search_depth: Maximum number of reflection + search iterations. Default: 2
    human_feedback: Enable human feedback on report plan. Default: true
    planner_provider: LLM provider for planning (e.g., 'openai'). Default: 'openai'
    planner_model: Model name for planning. Default: 'gpt-4.1'
    planner_model_kwargs: Additional keyword arguments for the planner model. Pass as JSON string (e.g., '{"temperature": 0.7}') or leave empty.
    writer_provider: LLM provider for writing (e.g., 'openai'). Default: 'openai'
    writer_model: Model name for writing. Default: 'gpt-4.1'
    writer_model_kwargs: Additional keyword arguments for the writer model. Pass as JSON string (e.g., '{"temperature": 0.7}') or leave empty.
    urls: Optional list of URLs or domains to restrict research to.
    url_mode: 'domain' uses Google search filtered to domains (default), 'scrape' limits scraping to the provided URLs. Must be 'domain' or 'scrape'.

Returns:
    A comprehensive research report as a string (or JSON string if json_report_format is provided).
